localization.name: Chemex 60g/L Half Liter
localization.short_description: Commentary-heavy Chemex transcript with filter-weight trivia

steps.description_source: Quick aside on filters -- a Chemex filter is noticeably heavier than a normal V60 filter, it actually weighs about 4.5 grams dry versus around 1.5 grams for a Hario paper, which is part of why the Chemex cup comes out so clean. Fold the filter, rinse it with hot water, and dose in 30 grams of coffee.
steps.description_template: Quick aside on filters -- a Chemex filter is noticeably heavier than a normal V60 filter, it actually weighs about 4.5 grams dry versus around 1.5 grams for a Hario paper, which is part of why the Chemex cup comes out so clean. Fold the filter, rinse it with hot water, and dose in 30 grams of coffee.

steps.description_source: In terms of the bloom, do exactly as the V60: 60 to 90 grams of bloom water, and let that bloom for at least 45 seconds.
steps.description_template: In terms of the bloom, do exactly as the V60: 60 to 90 grams of bloom water, and let that bloom for at least 45 seconds.

steps.description_source: Once the bloom settles, start pouring in slow concentric circles, pretty controlled, maybe 3 grams a second, avoiding the filter walls, until you reach the full 500 grams. You're gonna have four to five minute brew times brewing half a liter with the Chemex.
steps.description_template: Once the bloom settles, start pouring in slow concentric circles, pretty controlled, maybe 3 grams a second, avoiding the filter walls, until you reach the full 500 grams. You're gonna have four to five minute brew times brewing half a liter with the Chemex.

steps.description_source: At the end, give it a little stir and a swirl to help the drawdown and keep a flat bed, then just let it finish draining completely.
